optimization.method: Automated optical review and normalization on all SVG masters; undersized icons enlarged, off-center icons re-centered, simple low-fill icons received a slight stroke reinforcement, geometry preserved.

svgReview.colorVariants: Unchanged from 1.1.0 (SHA-256 verified for all 288 files)
svgReview.interfaceVariants: Layer knockout and silhouette fixes across 288 native SVG assets
svgReview.preserve: No bitmap embeds; vector clip paths, transparent, currentColor for interface
svgReview.colorPreservation: SHA-256 exact for 288 couleur files compared with V1.1 baseline
svgReview.badgeCleanup: 116 badges redrawn with lighter internal glyphs; transparent circular knockout in all badges

colorReliefReview.notes: No change to semantic ID or family. Gradients retained; badge overlap made transparent and shadow blur reduced.
